notes: Everything Feyre can carry. kind: weapon | ammo | food | material | keepsake. use: knife | bow | eat (what left-click does when the item is selected on the hotbar). A bow-type item fires the ammo named in 'ammo'. stack = most per slot. price = what a shop asks; sell = what a shop pays.

hunting_knife.name: Hunting Knife
hunting_knife.text: Wooden hilt, old blade, kept sharp. Left-click to slash toward the cursor.

bow.name: Hunting Bow
bow.text: Hold left-click to draw, release to loose. A full draw flies faster and hits harder. Fires plain arrows.

ash_arrow.name: Ash Arrow
ash_arrow.text: Long, heavy, mountain ash with an iron head. Select it to nock it on the bow. The stories say ash makes faerie healing falter.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.text: Plain fletching, iron tip. Shot arrows can be picked up again unless they break.

rose_hips.name: Rose Hips
rose_hips.text: Wrinkled red hips from a wild rose, sweeter after the frost. Restores 5 HP.

bread.name: Heel of Bread
bread.text: Dark rye, a day old. Restores 8 HP.

hare.name: Snow Hare
hare.text: Thin from the winter, but meat is meat. Worth a coin or two at market.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.text: Charcoal, black and ivory, and far too large. It will fetch a good price, if anyone believes where it came from.

doe_hide.name: Doe Hide
doe_hide.text: Clean and whole. A fair price at market.

doe_hide_torn.name: Torn Doe Hide
doe_hide_torn.text: Ripped by the wolf's teeth. Worth very little now.

snare_wire.name: Snare Wire
snare_wire.text: Good wire, carefully coiled, left behind by a hunter who never came back for it.

paint_tins.name: Elain's Paint Tins
paint_tins.text: Three small tins, red, yellow and blue, almost empty. The only gift Elain ever gave her.

iron_bracelet.name: Iron Bracelet
iron_bracelet.text: Plain iron, cold on the wrist. Every sensible mortal wears one. Nesta would approve.

table_knife.name: Dinner Knife
table_knife.text: Pocketed from the High Lord's own table. Blunt-tipped and barely a weapon, but better than nothing. Left-click to slash.

fae_knife.name: Emissary's Knife
fae_knife.text: A slim Fae blade Lucien left on the table for you, as if by accident. Light and wicked sharp. Left-click to slash.

jeweled_knife.name: Jeweled Hunting Knife
jeweled_knife.text: Lucien's gift, for the moment he hesitated. Perfectly balanced, a gold hilt set with rubies and emeralds. Left-click to slash.

chicken.name: Dead Hen
chicken.text: Freshly killed, courtesy of a baffled kitchen. Bait for a snare in the western woods.

honey_cake.name: Honey Cake
honey_cake.text: From the manor's kitchens, still warm, with a candied rose petal on top. Restores 10 HP.

chocolate.name: Molten Chocolate
chocolate.text: A thick mug of it, the best thing you have ever tasted. Restores 16 HP.

silver_purse.name: Purse of Silver
silver_purse.text: A small drawstring purse, heavy with silver. Father counted every coin into it, and still doesn't know what it's for.
